execution_invariants.batching_semantics: Internal checkpointing only within the same required production cycle; a batch size is never a daily throughput limit unless a future canonical contract explicitly says so.
execution_invariants.rule: The nightly production is one daily production cycle. GitHub performs the deterministic work it can and ChatGPT completes the remaining required semantic/external work for that same cycle. Do not convert checkpoint sizes, legacy task limits, or temporary handoff notes into a per-day game quota.

commercial_refresh.rule: Treat the completed nightly GitHub snapshot as the commercial state for the whole day. Do not fetch fresher price, discount, review, history, Store or SteamDB data when the user opens or refreshes the visualization.

night_input_freshness.stale_action: do not replace the last successful daily visual payload
night_input_freshness.rule: The 01:00 preparation may consume only a complete pre-AI payload whose source_mailing_updated_at_utc is present, parseable and no more than 18 hours old at preparation time. This prevents silent reuse of an old commercial snapshot after a failed nightly GitHub chain.

known_expiry_guard.rule: Known sale_end_utc values may be applied while producing the daily snapshot. Opening or refreshing the visualization during the day must not perform a new semantic or commercial recalculation.

responsibilities: consume the completed nightly pre-AI payload
verify source_mailing_updated_at_utc is present, parseable and no more than 18 hours old; otherwise fail closed without replacing the last successful daily visual payload
finish any required price-blind taste verdicts and persist them through taste inbox/checkpoint
wait until the current production contract is complete and the AI taste queue is closed
consume precomputed purchase context and deal scenarios
produce all user-facing semantic fields including eligibility, offer-family choice, deal verdict, reasons, risks and strict priority_rank
build and persist data/production/visual/current.json through the daily visual producer
allow the read-only Pages deploy to publish that prepared payload
on failure do not replace the last successful complete visual payload

visualization_consumption.user_behavior: The user opens the visualization at any convenient time during the day and sees the already prepared frozen daily snapshot.
allowed_work: manage local UI state such as tabs, gallery, cursor, progress and explicit manual queue changes
visualization_consumption.rule: Opening or refreshing the visualization is read-only with respect to daily semantics and external commercial data.

morning_delivery.rule: The separate 08:00 mailing/delivery is abolished. Do not schedule, recreate or attempt a morning push delivery; the visualization replaces it.

daily_ready_manifest.rule: This block is retained only so the old handoff validator and historical artifacts remain understandable. It must not be used to recreate an 08:00 delivery.
